Alberto Jesus Gutierrez was arrested and booked into the Webb County Jail on November 4, 2026, at 10:41 PM, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking record.

The booking record does not show an arresting agency.

Gutierrez is charged with alleged possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 1, 4 grams or more but less than 200 grams, a second-degree felony. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

These are allegations only. Gutierrez is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
